text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the Arima Kinen has<n>arrived, and the
stage is set for the<n>ultimate sibling showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide can't even remember<n>the last time
she and her sister raced<n>each other. While
acknowledging<n>Narita Brian's abilities, she
proclaims<n>that she will win this climactic
confrontation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This time, she will be the one to<n>triumph! The final
showdown with<n>Narita Brian the Beast begins!
